messages:
DeployBot: initiating staged rollout v3.2.0 -> 15% traffic (eu-west) at 15:28 UTC. change-window 15:28-16:00. rollout-id=rl-4872. notifying @Alice @Ben for stop/go.
Alice: saw the kickoff, watching p95/p99 for /embed and /chat routes.
Ben: already seeing p95 for /embed up ~120ms vs baseline (~40ms) since shift to new kv-cache eviction. small but steady.
Carla: graph snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/shot/rl-4872 (short) — p95 spike aligns with first wave of traffic.
DeployBot: canary-check failed: p95 > 100ms threshold for 3m on route=/embed in eu-west. auto-notify set.
Nate: suggestion — pause and quench traffic to 10% while we investigate, or rollback to v3.1.9. which is faster to execute?
Ben: rollback is fastest. quench requires a config tweak and another rollout step. rollback path tested last week.
Alice: +1 rollback to v3.1.9 for eu-west, then we can repro locally with the new eviction config. avoid global reroute.
Carla: agree. also let's pin model-serving pods to older kernel for eu-west until we confirm cache behavior.
Helen: quick vote: HOLD the progressive rollout. @DeployBot pause rl-4872. Ben to run rollback.
DeployBot: acknowledged. pausing rollout rl-4872 now. current traffic remains at 15% until rollback.
Ben: running rollback now — will execute targeted undo on eu-west deployment. snippet:```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/serve-v3 --to-revision=202```
Ben: rolling back, starting drain of new pods, bringing v3.1.9 replicas back. ETA ~90s.
Alice: I'll monitor p95/p99 and tail error rates, will report if rollback restores baseline.
Carla: tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform for root-cause: @eng-runtime please triage kv-cache eviction tune.
Nate: leaving a note in the release ticket about needing a canary-run with loadgen after fix.
DeployBot: rollback complete for rl-4872 in eu-west. current traffic now on v3.1.9. manual confirmation required.
Alice: p95 back to baseline within 2 minutes. no elevated errors. :thumbsup:
Helen: good call. leave rollout paused until eng-runtime posts remediation and we have a regression test.
Ben: will open a pinned revert PR and add a postmortem checklist.
Carla: filing follow-up: reproduce eviction behavior on staging, add stricter p95 gating for embed route.
Nate: thanks everyone. reschedule a short post-incident sync at 16:30 if needed.
DeployBot: thread closed for rl-4872 hold; update ticket #RL-4872 with next steps.
Alice: ack.
